summary: A reading of 1945, the 1995 alternate-history novel by then-Speaker Newt Gingrich in which a victorious Nazi Germany attacks East Tennessee, set against his combative career and the book's commercial flop.

evidence.note: Gingrich biography starts with his 1943 birth and Vietnam-era deferment
Speakership 1995-99 and the 1994 Contract with America election
anti-gay-rights stance and affair while pursuing Clinton impeachment
Baen printed huge runs expecting a hit; most copies returned, nearly sinking the publisher
opening chapter: politician self-insert leaks atomic secret to a Nazi spy mistress
novel's Nazi super weapons and Skorzeny as main villain
airborne SS invasion of Tennessee repelled by Alvin York's militia of veterans

notes: No theme for literature or publishing; electoral-politics chosen as primary because the episode frames the novel through Gingrich's career, with nazism and war themes coming from the fictional plot. US-TN reflects the novel's central fictional setting. Covered span follows the Gingrich biography segment (1943 to end of speakership in 1999); the novel's fictional 1945 falls inside it.
